declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The settlement was reached through arm’s-length negotiations between class counsel and Brightline’s counsel. The parties negotiated the class relief and attorneys’ fees as part of the settlement package; fees were not first discussed only after class relief had been agreed. I do not disclose confidential mediation communications or negotiation positions. The resulting agreement provides a $34 million class fund, automatic payments to identified members, and fees of $6 million subject to court approval, with no clear-sailing provision and any unawarded fees going to the class. In my assessment, the settlement reasonably accounts for the risks and delay of continued litigation, including the unresolved certification question, while providing substantial, direct relief without requiring class members to submit claims.
